# Logo fixtures

Stand-in logos for the marquee stories, served by Storybook at `/fixtures/logos/`.

- The wordmarks (Brightfold, Fernvale, Kitewell, Lumora, Northpine, Quillmark) are invented.
- The technology marks are path data from Simple Icons 16.35.0 (CC0-1.0,
  https://simpleicons.org), as in `src/components/sections/tech-icons.tsx`. They are
  trademarks of their owners, used here only to name the tools.
